description: This file defines a NetworkMonitor class that observes network connectivity status changes using Apple's Network framework. It provides an observable property 'isOnline' to indicate whether the device is connected to a network.

classes.name: NetworkMonitor
classes.description: A class that monitors network connectivity status and publishes updates to observers.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the NetworkMonitor, sets up the path update handler to update 'isOnline' based on network status, and starts monitoring.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up the monitor by cancelling it when the object is deallocated.
